ValidationRule.description: Blocks move to Closed or Pending Review for critical categories when required clinical fields are empty.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(Status__c), OR( ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Closed"), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Pending Review") ), OR( ISPICKVAL(Event_Category__c, "Death"), ISPICKVAL(Event_Category__c, "Serious Health Concern") ), OR( ISBLANK(TEXT(Observation_Type__c)), ISBLANK(Behavioral_Notes__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Observation Type and Behavioral Notes are required before moving this critical event to Pending Review or Closed.
